findings.passage: A champion for underdogs, vulnerable communities, and those too often left without a voice, Stella Pekarsky is grounded in the values that have guided her life and public service: investing in public education, protecting reproductive freedom, reducing gun violence, and standing up to corporate special interests
findings.note: Biography text on her campaign site, which lists reducing gun violence among her guiding values. Page is undated.
